title: Breakout Siege 3D
description: Hold the line against relentless waves of armored foes—upgrade tactical weapons, dodge incoming fire, and blast a path out of the encirclement.
controls: Drag to move and aim your trooper while automatically firing at nearby enemies and collecting power-ups.

zh-CN.title: 激战突围
zh-CN.description: 硬核爽快 3D 射击激战突围：端起火力全开的武器冲破重重敌军包围，灵活走位点杀精英怪杀出一条血路！
zh-CN.controls: 拖动虚拟摇杆控制走位走射，收集战场增益道具击溃四面八方围攻的敌人。
